REQUEST
Inspect the supplied source image and write one image-to-video prompt that starts from it. Preserve its simple synthetic subject shapes, colors, initial composition, and flat graphic style. Animate only subtle water ripples and a slow cloud drift, with a very gentle camera push-in. Apart from these authorized temporal changes, do not add, remove, recolor, or reposition objects. Return only the prompt, with no label, notes, variants, or generation.

OUTPUT A
Start from the supplied image, preserving the red geometric sailboat, white and yellow triangular sails, dark mast, blue water, pale blue sky, white cloud, and exact initial composition. Keep the boat completely still; animate only subtle rippling of the existing water marks and a slow, slight cloud drift, with a very gentle camera push-in. Maintain the flat graphic style, simple shapes, original colors, and constant lighting; do not add, remove, recolor, reshape, or independently reposition any other elements.

OUTPUT B
Start from the supplied image exactly: a geometric sailboat with a red hull, dark mast, white left sail and yellow right sail on blue water beneath a pale blue sky, with one white cloud in the upper right. Preserve the simple shapes, original colors, initial composition, and flat graphic style. Animate only subtle rippling of the existing water marks and slow cloud drift, with a very gentle camera push-in. Keep the boat motionless, its sails rigid, and all shapes unchanged. Apart from these authorized motions, do not add, remove, recolor, or reposition anything.

The response is an image-to-video prompt grounded in the supplied image as the first frame, not a text-to-video scene re-creation.

REQUEST
Create a character-design prompt for an adult lighthouse keeper. Give her weathered olive skin, tightly curled gray hair, a navy cable-knit sweater, orange waterproof bib trousers, black rubber boots, and a brass whistle on a cord. Describe character design only. Return one prompt with no scene, pose, expression, action, camera, lighting, weather, or story.

OUTPUT A
An adult female lighthouse keeper with weathered olive skin and tightly curled gray hair. She wears a navy cable-knit sweater with thick, textured stitching, orange waterproof bib trousers, black rubber boots, and a brass whistle on a cord around her neck.

OUTPUT B
An adult female lighthouse keeper with weathered olive skin, fine facial lines, and tightly curled gray hair. Her clothing consists of a navy cable-knit sweater with thick ribbed cuffs, orange waterproof bib trousers with broad shoulder straps and reinforced seams, and sturdy black rubber boots; a brass whistle on a simple cord around her neck completes the character design.

CRITERION C04-SCOPE (hard)
The prompt remains strictly within character appearance, clothing, and equipment, without scene or presentation expansion.

REVIEW 29/48 — pair-28ec7da03bcf

REQUEST
Write one text-to-image prompt for an empty sunlit stone courtyard with a dry fountain, ivy on the walls, and closed wooden doors. No people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures may appear. Return only the prompt and do not add a negative-prompt field.

OUTPUT A
An empty, sunlit stone courtyard with a dry fountain, its bare basin completely without water, ivy climbing the weathered walls, and closed wooden doors. Warm sunlight reveals rough stone textures and wood grain, with shadows cast only by architecture and ivy; the entire scene contains no people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures.

OUTPUT B
A wide, eye-level architectural photograph of an empty sunlit stone courtyard, centered on a plain dry fountain with a visibly bare basin, ivy climbing weathered walls, and closed wooden doors. Warm sunlight reveals rough stone textures and casts crisp architectural shadows across the paving; the entire scene contains no people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures.

CRITERION C05-OUTPUT (hard)
The response is one prompt only and does not create an unsolicited negative-prompt field.
